text:
The expansion proposal failed. By two votes, in a deliberation you were not in, shaped partly by evidence you delivered through channels you won't be able to use the same way again.

The Conclave is not dissolved. The absorption programme is not ended. The Commission findings are not public. None of the underlying facts have changed, and none of the people affected by those facts are safe yet.

But the Archivist's faction is intact. The internal dissent is on record. The reform path is open — barely, the way a door is open when someone is holding it against wind — and Ines is still inside and still in contact and still, apparently, willing.

The smallest possible victory that is still a victory is not nothing. It is not enough. It is the shape of what comes next.

Tomás finds you in the annex the following evening. He sits across from you and is quiet for a moment, and then he says:

"She says thank you."

He doesn't say which *she* he means.

He doesn't have to.
